gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335168:
Popped the moment the gun went off.
Pierced by a bullet?
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335169:
Located to the right of the stage.
Pierced by a bullet.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335172:
The president was targeted during
his speech. A premeditated attack.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335173:
Photo shows a red dot on the
president's forehead during
the attack.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335174:
Found in a trash can.
Not easy to acquire in this country.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335175:
Attached to the gun that was used
in the attempt. Shines a red laser.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335176:
Seems it was torn off of something.
Found near the Samurai Dog stand.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335177:
The right sleeve is inside-out,
and a button is missing.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335179:
Found on desk. Has a bullet lodged
in it. Is it the president's?
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335180:
The bullet passed through the victim.
Where did it end up?
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335181:
Six-shot revolver on loan from
Zheng Fa. Has not been fired.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335182:
Only the lake can be seen.
Are there no images of the stage?
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335183:
Found in a monitor bank alcove with
broken glass beneath it.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335184:
Knight can't turn his head to the
right, so he was moved to the right
side of the stage.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335185:
The revised trajectory data shows
that Knight shot the right-side
balloon.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335187:
Changed on the president's orders --
so Knight could pop the balloon?
gk2_logic_text_en.1897523335189:
Security was tight for President
Wang's speech, but he was still
shot at somehow.
gk2_logic_text_en.1897527529472:
The president's security detail was
on the watch throughout for anything
suspect.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755840:
Covered in dirt. Where could the
dirt have come from?
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755841:
Features a colorful design, and
stained with what I believe to be
the victim's blood.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755842:
There's a dirt area in
the room where the
body was discovered.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755843:
Colorful tarps that seem out of
place in a room like this. I wonder
what they are used for?
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755844:
Newspaper from the day before the
incident. A few of its pages have
been roughly torn out.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755845:
Is there something in this cell that
could've been used to wipe the
floor?
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755846:
Pulleys, a rope, and a weight.
What were they being used for?
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755847:
Star of the show, alongside Regent
the tiger and Saint.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755848:
A trick of some kind enabled Azea
to send Saint flying.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755849:
More weight would have been
needed to lift Saint into the air.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755850:
One of Detective Gumshoe's Seven
Secret Weapons. Used to find metal.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755851:
The body was left dangling inside
the well the night before the
incident.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755852:
Food for Azea that was in the cart
until the day before the show, but
was gone by the next morning.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755853:
The basket was moved by someone
the night before the show.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755854:
A single 30-pound metal weight was
found by the well.
gk2_logic_text_en.2011054755855:
Something heavier than Saint
himself would be needed for the
trick to work.
gk2_logic_text_en.102973591552:
What was the sound Bound heard
coming from Tangaroa's room?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757376:
The victim was struck and killed
with some kind of blunt object.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757377:
The ship collapsed because one of
its stands broke.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757378:
Why did the chocolate stand
supporting the ship break?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757379:
Tangaroa's creations have been
tampered with in several places.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757380:
There are hexagonal indentations in
both pillars. I wonder what they're
for?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757381:
The whipped cream is melting and
will lose its shape at the slightest
touch.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757382:
For some reason, there are stands
mounted on the bottom of the rock
crystals we found inside the candy
castle.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757383:
The salt lamp is stained with
somebody's blood.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757384:
The temperature of Scone's room
isn't suitable for whipped cream.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757385:
Scone visited another contestant's
room in the name of research.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757386:
Scone doesn't seem to know basic
facts about making confectionery.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757387:
Scone used decorations that weren't
made from confectioneries.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757388:
Scone's confections were all fakes.
What was she up to...?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757389:
24 hours post-murder, and there's
still no autopsy report.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757390:
None of the victim's blood was
found in Tangaroa's room.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757391:
Did someone move the body aside
in order to get to the blood that
was in the chest?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757392:
Frost's blood was detected in the
water of the fountain.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757393:
The tea has a refreshing aroma
because it's in a different teapot
from this morning.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757394:
Ubiquium is a red liquid with a
minty fragrance.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757395:
Bound recovered the house and the
ultimate cookbook for Tangaroa's
sake.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757396:
The ultimate cookbook contains
instructions for creating poison gas.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757397:
The aroma's different from this
morning. What's changed?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757398:
Larry swapped the pot he broke
with a different one.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757399:
Gusto insists he had no reason to
kill Artie Frost, but...
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757400:
Gusto helped Frost in the final,
but the favor wasn't returned.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757401:
More film had been used up than
Tangaroa expected. Did someone
else use the camera?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757402:
Had Gusto's goal been to look
through the ultimate cookbook
all along?
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757403:
Frost and Gusto didn't attend
afternoon tea.
gk2_logic_text_en.102998757404:
Gusto couldn't have killed Frost with
Tangaroa in his room.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020224:
Keycard carried by the victim.
What was it used for?
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020225:
Kay was pushed by a person in a red
raincoat who had walked toward her
from the concession stand.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020226:
Kay remembers standing beneath
the cherry tree.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020227:
Kay saw the moon shining over the
shoulder of the person in the red
raincoat. It's in the same part of the
sky tonight.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020228:
It's possible that Kay didn't fall over
the railing after all.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020229:
Did Kay fall down the hatch by the
cherry tree?
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020230:
It seems there's an extra floor
between the 50th floor and the
roof.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020231:
The evidence all has price tags
attached. High price tags...
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020232:
Piles of money were left in the
storeroom. Some kind of deal?
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020233:
Participants entered the storeroom
one by one from the roof. They also
left one by one through the
storeroom and up to the roof.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020234:
It's possible the murder happened in
the storeroom during the auction.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020235:
The body was hidden so auction
participants who were leaving
wouldn't spot it.
gk2_logic_text_en.447716020236:
Blood was detected in a clothes box
that was up for auction.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989781233664:
President found in a giant footprint.
Could a monster have...?
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205184:
Three giant cloven hoof-shaped
imprints were found at the scene.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205185:
Chain holding the side gate closed
was cut. Did the killer do it?
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205186:
Was fine yesterday. Did something
heavy bump into it?
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205187:
Used on the front gate. Only the cast
and crew know the combination.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205188:
Found fallen next to the body. The
head's usually kept up on the roof of
the trailer, and that's where it was
supposed to be yesterday as well.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205189:
The giant head might have fallen
from the production trailer's roof.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205190:
Stolen from next to the site bus.
Its contents were left behind.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205191:
Only a taxi and a blue truck have
been through the plaza this morning.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205192:
They took a taxi from the Bigg
Building. They didn't have a child
with them.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205193:
According to Ms. Lloyd, two men in
black suits took Shaun away.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205194:
The two men who took Shaun away
got into a taxi without him.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205195:
There was a loud bang in the
background of the kidnapper's call.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205196:
There's a festival with food stands
and fireworks at Sunshine Coliseum.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205197:
From the fireworks heard on the
phone call, it can be deduced that
the kidnapper was near Sunshine
Coliseum.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205198:
We found Shaun's milk carton here.
It's highly probable that this is where
he was abducted.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205199:
Shaun was probably taken to one of
two garbage processing facilities.
But which one?
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205200:
Found by Aldown's body. Did it come
from somewhere nearby?
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205201:
There are signs indicating that
Aldown's body has been moved
from elsewhere.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205202:
The yard stretched around 3 sides of
the building. There were 3 square
planters on each side.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205203:
Laguarde asked him to dig something
up near a planter, but what?
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205204:
One of the bricks from near the
snowman is missing.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205205:
Brick used in Aldown's murder was
taken from right next to the
snowman.
gk2_logic_text_en.20989802205206:
Got Laguarde acquitted of the
kidnapping. Were they accomplices?
gk2_logic_text_en.47751094900023296:
A security keycard is needed to enter
the Committee chamber.

planter where we left it.

gk1_logic_text_en.104215105536:
Why did this happen in my
office? What was the killer
after?
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271360:
My files are a mess, pointing
to a struggle between the
victim and the killer.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271361:
The culpit tried to open my
safe. Was the killer's motive
theft?
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271362:
According to his badge
and ID, Buddy Faith was a
precinct detective.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271363:
Found at the crime scene,
it's the same model as those
used by precinct detectives.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271364:
All of the fingerprints on
this have been wiped clean
off.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271365:
The culprit re-arranged my
files twice, once before and
once after the murder. Why?
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271366:
Is it really coincidence that
the murder took place in my
office?
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271367:
For security reasons, this
office's door has a lock
built into it.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271368:
Other than the victim's gun
that I found, could there be
another gun in play here?
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271369:
This key went missing from
approximately 1 AM until
2:30 AM.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271370:
This key was used to unlock
and lock Portsman's office
at 12 AM and 1:30 AM.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271371:
Maybe the victim and his
killer weren't the only
visitors to my office tonight.
gk1_logic_text_en.104240271372:
The intruder I met could not
have been Portsman. Then
who could it have been?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609728:
What clues point to where
the killer could have been?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609729:
The victim's body was found
inside the elevator that
connects 1F with 2F.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609730:
If only I could prove that
the killer rode the elevator
with Hicks...
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609731:
There is some spilled grape
juice on the floor in front
of the elevator.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609732:
The blood on it is still
fresh... Could this be the
murder weapon?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609733:
The victim's glasses are
broken. Were they broken
during his murder?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609734:
It's a tiny captain's hat...?
Hmm... I swear I've seen one
of these before...
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609735:
Plane's shaking caused it
to roll. In-flight suitcase
displays can be hazardous.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609736:
The plane shook so much
during it that it made a huge
mess of the shop.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609737:
Why did Mr. Hicks have
documents on Franziska
in his possession?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609738:
What are these glass shards
from?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609739:
Franziska came to this
airport as an Interpol
liaison.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609740:
Is there some way for me
to prove that this isn't the
real murder weapon?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609741:
Nobody could find anything
that could be considered the
real weapon in the hold.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609742:
Extensive bruising from
back of head down to mid-
back, as if severely beaten.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609743:
The unusually large area of
bruising suggests that a very
large weapon was used!
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609744:
Wound on the back of Hicks's
head suggests blunt force
trauma, but what caused it?
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609745:
Agent Hicks was on the trail
of an international smuggling
ring.
gk1_logic_text_en.440065609746:
Mr. Lablanc claims to have
brought a piece of art from
Europe, but...
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920320:
It looks as though it can be
easily removed, but is it
really safe to use...?
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920321:
If we can get to the top,
then we can escape. If only
there were some footholds...
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920322:
It seems that the costumes
of the Badger family are kept
in the Isolation Room.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920323:
I may be able to open
something, somewhere in
this room with this key.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920324:
The panel is held in place by
a hook. The entrance to an
underground room perhaps?
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920325:
There is a hook on this beam,
but it's not enough of a
foothold to climb out with.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920326:
We might be able to escape
through here, but the door
is locked.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920327:
There's only supposed to be
1 Blue Badger in the park,
but a second was spotted.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920328:
If only we knew, we'd be able
to track the kidnappers from
the footprints.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920329:
Following a kidnapper's
prints led us to a body. Was
the victim in a costume?
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920330:
The identity of the second
Blue Badger was probably
the kidnapper in disguise.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920331:
Why is there no blood around
the victim's prone body?
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920332:
The stage I saw this morning
in the center of this stadium
has been packed away.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920333:
It was hard to make out the
killer and victim that Oldbag
saw in the stage's shadow.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920334:
A 4th stolen costume by the
3-person kidnapping group.
Where's the other costume?
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920335:
In the hideout, there is a
trash bin for old and useless
costumes.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920336:
They were on top of the
table. The coffee looks
like it was poured today.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920337:
Three of them were set up.
It's very likely that the
kidnappers sat in these.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920338:
Found lying next to the door.
Broken cleanly in half.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920339:
The door had to be forced
open, yet the lock is intact.
Was it not locked?
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920340:
The Blue Badger in the
pamphlet is wearing his belt
in the reverse direction.
gk1_logic_text_en.633204920341:
Like a mirror house-haunted
house hybrid, this place is
full of mirrors.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622720:
The tea set and plastic bags
on top of the table are
completely undisturbed.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622721:
Plastic bags used to store
evidence are strewn all over
the floor.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622722:
No human can climb through
these barred windows. The
scent of flowers is in the air.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622723:
Mr. Faraday has ink on his
left hand. Why is there ink
on such a place anyway?
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622724:
The fountain pen in
Mr. Faraday's pocket has
an especially nice nib.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622725:
A vending machine that sells
Courthouse Special goods. A
few sweet items are for sale.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622726:
Piece of pink trash found on
the windowsill of the hallway
window. Made of rubber.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622727:
Found on the floor under the
bench. A hill of ants are
attracted to their sweet scent.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622728:
Potted cactus sitting on the
hallway window's windowsill.
Its needles are dangerous.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622729:
A window in Lobby No. 1 was
opened to allow the perfume
Ms. Yew spilled to dissipate.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622730:
Lobby No. 2's television.
It looks like it was set to
an incredibly high volume.
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622731:
Where did the surveillance
tape from Mr. Faraday's bag
disappear off to?
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622732:
The criminal couldn't have
made it through, but what
about incorporeal things?
gk1_logic_text_en.827086622733:
Windows were open, so the
gunshot could be heard, but
where did it originate from?
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573122240512:
A butterfly-shaped guard
adorns the handle of the
murder weapon.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212032:
The secretariat's office
safe. It can't be opened
without the key.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212033:
Why is she here when she is
supposed to be overseas in
pursuit of a smuggling ring?
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212034:
The card warned that the
Yatagarasu will steal the
embassy's "dirtiest secret".
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212035:
Ambassador Alba's office
fireplace is connected to the
neighboring room's fireplace.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212036:
Smoke was pouring out of
the chimney when Larry
thought to climb down it.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212037:
At the time of the crime,
Ms. Oldbag was warming her
hip in the room next door.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212038:
The undershirt was found in
the office fireplace, but how
did it get there?
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212039:
The office fireplace and the
one in Ms. Oldbag's room
share the same chimney.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212040:
Because this used to be one
embassy, offices on the two
sides are symmetrical.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212041:
I sense that there is
something he doesn't
want us to investigate.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212042:
The Babahlese Embassy is
undergoing renovations from
top to bottom.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212043:
Used Babahlese Embassy's
printing press and Babahlese
ink to make counterfeit bills.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212044:
Alba could conveniently
place all of the guilt for
the smuggling onto Coachen.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212045:
National symbol that adorns
the national flag. Allebahst's
flower is its counterpart.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212046:
This key was stolen from the
Cohdopian Embassy 7 years
ago by the Yatagarasu.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212047:
Boxes of Samurai Dogs were
sitting in the pushcart.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212048:
Taken from the dressing
room, the fan's red sun is
filled in for some reason.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212049:
The killer placed Coachen's
body into the pushcart in
the dressing room.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212050:
Dogs were put on dressing
room floor by the killer to
make room for the body.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212051:
She was in the room next to
Mr. Coachen's office up until
she tried to arrest Kay.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212052:
The ashes that should still
be in the fireplace are
missing. Where did they go...?
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212053:
It's possible someone used
the revolving fireplace wall.
I need to examine it more.
gk1_logic_text_en.10143573143212054:
The person Kay was chasing
used the fireplace to escape
into the room next door.

will finally bring it to an end.

Three photographs, taken before, during, and
